card.name: The word by before route of administration
card.fires_on: The word "by" (or "BY") right before a route of giving a drug, such as oral, intravenous, mouth or other routes. Usually follows a dose or "given/administered".

modes.label: By after a dose
modes.description: "by" follows a dose amount and leads into the route.
modes.example: Administer 75 mg<< by>> intravenous infusion every 3 hours until

modes.label: By after given or administered
modes.description: "by" follows a verb like given or administered and leads into a route.
modes.example: ATED FOR INTRAVENOUS USE ONLY – FATAL IF GIVEN<< BY>> OTHER ROUTES (See WARNINGS ).

modes.label: By in headings
modes.description: "by" in a dosage heading, before a category such as indication.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Recommended Adult Dosage and Administration<< by>> Indication: To Stimulate Contraction

card.writes: It pushes the model toward "via" and "route", so a way of giving the drug comes next.
card.plain: It marks the word "by" when the text is about to say how a drug is given, such as by mouth or by vein.
